---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea, new output template, or format handler
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is. (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when [...]")

**Describe the Solution You'd Like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Target Component / Generator**
- [ ] Core Model & GUI (`RegMapTreeModel`, Bitfield Bar, Memory Map Widget)
- [ ] Format Parser / Serializer (ARM CMSIS-SVD, SystemRDL, IP-XACT, JSON, CSV, Protobuf)
- [ ] Code Generator Template (SystemVerilog RTL, UVM, C/C++, Rust PAC, Python, HTML, Markdown, etc.)
- [ ] CLI / Headless Automation (`--lint`, `--diff`, `--export`, `--convert`)
- [ ] Other (describe below)

**Example Syntax / Expected Output**
If proposing a new output format or code generator template, please provide an example of the desired generated output:
```systemverilog
// Example code snippet
```

**Describe Alternatives You've Considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Additional Context**
Add any other context, diagrams, or references about the feature request here.
